summaries.summary: A user discovers their ISP was hijacking DNS queries, leading to tampered IP addresses.
summaries.significance: This story highlights the prevalence of ISP DNS hijacking and the necessity of using encrypted DNS methods like DoT or DoH to ensure internet traffic integrity.
points: The user found the ISP's IP address when using standard DNS but a different IP with Cloudflare's DoH.
Only 7.03% of graded domains have a valid, fully validating DNSSEC chain.
The user uses Pi-hole/AdGuard for DNS and recommends DoT or DoH to prevent ISP snooping.

summaries.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability highlights the growing threat of AI in exploiting legacy software bugs.
points: A bug in PHP, reported in 2024, was exploited within two weeks using AI tools.
The vulnerability allowed running arbitrary code and reading critical data on host servers.
Experts suggest AI is making it easier for attackers to exploit legacy software, emphasizing the need for better cybersecurity funding and tools.

summaries.summary: Go introduces a new API for JSON handling, addressing issues with the existing API while maintaining compatibility.
points: New API includes options for handling JSON, such as rejecting duplicate names and managing nil slices.
Existing JSON package will continue to be supported, ensuring compatibility with older versions.
New API aims to improve performance and safety, though some limitations remain due to backward compatibility.

summaries.summary: A libc rewrite in Zig caused SQLite to become extremely slow in a chess analysis project.
points: SQLite insertions became 12,000x slower due to a Shlemiel the Painter problem.
The issue appeared only on Linux builds using Zig’s cc compiler for sqlite.
Fixing the problem involved moving Linux builds to Linux containers.

summaries.summary: Researchers have made progress on cryptographic proofs to verify that AI model responses come from the claimed model.
points: Researchers from Anthropic and other institutions developed a system called FlashProve to generate proofs for AI model responses.
FlashProve can generate proofs at around 110 tokens/second for a 400B-parameter model using a single H100 GPU.

summaries.summary: The article debunks common conspiracy theories about the NSA and NIST's role in cryptography standards.
points: DES was standardized in 1977 with 56-bit security, reduced from 128 bits by NSA.
NSA modified DES's S-boxes, which were initially suspected of having a backdoor but were later found to resist differential cryptanalysis.
Clipper Chip, promoted by NSA in 1993, had a backdoor for government access, unlike DES.

summaries.summary: Conductor is being integrated into Meta, with services winding down over the coming months.
points: Conductor Cloud transitions to read-only mode on November 13, fully shutting down on November 20.
Local Conductor will continue to receive updates and critical bug fixes until early 2027.
Users can transfer cloud workspaces to their Mac and download all data via specific settings options.

summaries.summary: AI advancements in weight-space programming and model optimizations were discussed at AIEi Shanghai, highlighting various models' capabilities and performance improvements.
summaries.significance: The story highlights advancements in AI's ability to generate and edit neural network weights directly, impacting future AI development and efficiency.
points: GPT-6 Astra edited 131,072 weights in Qwen3.5-0.8B, raising MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%.
Tencent's model ranks #14 overall with a 75.2 score on APEX-Agents, outperforming DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017.
Pruna's open model, distilled from MiniMax-H3, produces a 4 MP image in 2.6 seconds, priced at $0.30/$1.20.

summaries.summary: Datasette Apps 0.3a0 release enhances hosting and editing of custom HTML applications within Datasette.
points: Apps can be tagged in Datasette Agent chat messages using # for autocompletion.
New tools allow managing stored queries an app can call, requiring user approval for write queries.
"View app" buttons and # app links now open apps full screen in the Datasette Agent panel.

summaries.summary: Datasette Agent 0.5a0 introduces a new panel feature that allows chatting alongside Datasette pages.
points: New panel feature enables chatting next to Datasette pages like tables or queries.
Feature works with datasette-apps to create and modify database-backed apps via chat.
Users can try the new feature by signing in with their GitHub account at agent.datasette.io.
